oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an Oil Control System that calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Driving in severe conditions will shorten the interval. When the oil replacement indicator appears in the vehicle information display, the engine oil and filter must be replaced. After replacing, reset the display. If the indicator is displayed, change within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km).
severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go rush hour traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
extraction_caveats: 1. Tire rotation: The manual explicitly states tires CANNOT be rotated on this vehicle because front tires are a different size and/or wheel rim offset than the rear tires – therefore no tire rotation item is recorded. 2. Differential gear oil replacement interval for non-LSD models: The schedule only specifies replacement 'with limited slip differential'; no replacement interval is stated for standard differential models (inspection only). 3. Engine valve clearance has no fixed mileage/time interval – inspect only if valve noise increases. 4. Fuel specification detail (octane rating) is referenced to P.374 which was not included in the provided pages; the fuel capacity (16-3/8 gal) is captured from P.380. 5. Engine oil capacity for standard AT and MT models is the same (5-5/8 qt with filter / 5-3/8 qt drain-and-refill); NISMO also uses the same oil capacity per P.380 (the table does not show a separate NISMO oil capacity). 6. The standard maintenance schedule brake fluid replacement pattern (every 20,000 miles / 24 months) is derived by reading across all schedule columns (20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k, 120k); the severe schedule replacement pattern (every 10,000 miles / 12 months) is similarly derived. 7. Engine drive belts first appear at 60,000 miles then at every subsequent 10,000-mile standard interval through 120,000 miles; the repeat interval recorded reflects this pattern. 8. Intercooler coolant is described as maintenance-free with no scheduled replacement interval; it is captured as a fluid specification only. 9. The manual transmission gear oil and differential gear oil are listed for inspection at every 10,000-mile standard interval but no mandatory replacement interval is specified for non-LSD differential or MT gear oil beyond the inspection entries. 10. Engine coolant capacity on P.380 is listed under 'Intercooler coolant' section, not 'Engine coolant' – the AT/MT/NISMO coolant capacities shown are for the intercooler system; engine coolant capacities with reservoir are 9-1/2 qt (AT), 9-3/8 qt (MT), 11 qt (NISMO), reservoir only 5/8 qt.
